prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: draw each object inside its grey box, as described. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the box in the top row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (96x144 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a big round leafy oak tree seen in three-quarter view: a wide bushy crown in three greens lit from the upper left with darker shade underneath, and a thick brown trunk with roots at the bottom centre; it fills the box.
- the box in the top row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a market stall seen from the front in three-quarter view: a wooden counter table under a red-and-white striped cloth awning on four wooden poles, with baskets of red apples, bread loaves and green vegetables on the table; it fills the box.
- the box in the middle row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (48x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a black iron street lamp post with a warm glowing yellow lantern at the top, as tall as the box.
- the box in the middle row of boxes, fourth position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a wooden park bench with iron legs seen from the front.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). one section of a neatly clipped dark-green box hedge running left to right, in the lower two thirds of the box, touching both the left and the right edge of the box (so sections join into a long hedge).
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, second position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a small square vegetable bed of dark brown soil with two rows of round green cabbages, filling the box.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, fourth position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). two floating green lily pads and one small pink water-lily flower, with no water drawn around them.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
